redesign.rationale: I got a little confused as to what it was asking me when I cancelled. I assumed that the cancel would stop everything completely, but it paused and then had a vague instruction afterwards. But here the user should know that it has stopped for now but that it is not completely cancelled until they confirm it or give it a new command.
